why: The mark is FFA-only by the owner's direction on #234, and the guard that makes it so is one clause easily read as redundant beside the `identityMarker !== null` it sits with. Dropping it puts a per-slot shape on a teams entry, which already carries the A/B/C letter as its non-colour channel -- so the entry would state its side twice in two different vocabularies, and a 2v2 would show four different marks for two teams. That is worse than the colour-only strip this arm exists to improve on, and it is invisible in FFA, which is where every capture is taken.
killedBy: hud: identity mark in the stock strip (issue #778) leaves TEAMS untouched -- the letter is already that entry second channel
